notes.recognition: The joined twin-peak silhouette reads instantly as difficult mountain terrain.
notes.agency: Its narrow pass implies traversal pressure while leaving route signaling to the game.
notes.specificity: Layered slate planes and one restrained quartz seam avoid generic fantasy mountains.
notes.restraint: One connected ridge with broad faces and no manufactured ornament.
notes.continuity: Cool mineral planes and matte creases fit the approved slate material.
notes.reusability: Clean alpha and a grounded ridge base support varied scale and placement.
notes.accessibility: The strong peak silhouette survives color loss, though the dark internal planes need restrained runtime tinting.
